name: ModelCommitStep
documentation:
One ordered original event and all model targets affected by it.

{@link #event} may be {@code null} only for a non-stored, non-published transition such as {@code EventPublication.NEVER}. Such a transition still receives a state index when it updates model state.

fields.name: event
fields.documentation:
Serialized original event, stored only once in this request even when several models are targeted.

An event which already has an index refers to that exact existing event in the global event log and must not be published again.

fields.name: publishEvent
fields.documentation:
Whether the original event should be appended once to the global event log. This is always {@code false} when
 {@link #event} already carries its durable global index.

fields.name: targets
fields.documentation: Model stream/state targets of this original event.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.documentation: Complete serialized event-message bytes carried by this substep.

methods.name: getRelationCount
methods.documentation: Number of desired current parent relationships carried by all targets.

methods.name: getStoredTargetCount
methods.documentation: Number of target streams receiving an event membership.
